source.label: Arkansas General Assembly / BLR — 2026 Educational Adequacy Study Funding Overview Report
source.constitutional_cite: Ark. Const. Art. 14, § 3(b)(1) — uniform rate of ad valorem property tax of 25 mills

definition: Estimated local taxes = 98% of URT × assessment for traditional districts — the local foundation funding stream tied to the constitutional 25-mill Uniform Rate of Tax. Not total school property-tax collections (additional M&O and debt millages sit above URT).
recipients: Traditional public school district foundation funding (maintenance and operation)
State foundation aid fills shortfalls relative to foundation amount; 98% URT guarantee

legal_dependency.note: Complete retirement of school URT property taxation requires constitutional redesign/amendment after demonstrated replacement capacity.
